+"""Parse truth values without importing pytest configuration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+
+__all__ = ["strtobool_trimmed"]
+
+
+def strtobool_trimmed(val: str) -> bool:
+    """Convert a string representation of truth to True or False.
+
+    Ignore surrounding whitespace and letter case. True values are 'y',
+    'yes', 't', 'true', 'on', and '1'; false values are 'n', 'no', 'f',
+    'false', 'off', and '0'. Raise ValueError for anything else.
+    """
+    val = val.strip().lower()
+    if val in ("y", "yes", "t", "true", "on", "1"):
+        return True
+    elif val in ("n", "no", "f", "false", "off", "0"):
+        return False
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"invalid truth value {val!r}")
diff --git a/testing/test_standalone_trimmed_truth.py b/testing/test_standalone_trimmed_truth.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..ac0c86744
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_standalone_trimmed_truth.py
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+from standalone_trimmed_truth import strtobool_trimmed
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("token", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("y", True),
+        ("yes", True),
+        ("t", True),
+        ("true", True),
+        ("on", True),
+        ("1", True),
+        ("n", False),
+        ("no", False),
+        ("f", False),
+        ("false", False),
+        ("off", False),
+        ("0", False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_strtobool_trimmed(token: str, expected: bool) -> None:
+    assert strtobool_trimmed(token) is expected
+    assert strtobool_trimmed(f"\u2003\t{token.upper()}\r\n ") is expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("value", "normalized"),
+    [("", ""), (" \t\n", ""), (" UNKNOWN ", "unknown"), (" T RUE ", "t rue")],
+)
+def test_strtobool_trimmed_invalid(value: str, normalized: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as excinfo:
+        strtobool_trimmed(value)
+    assert str(excinfo.value) == f"invalid truth value {normalized!r}"
+
+
+def test_standalone_import_by_path() -> None:
+    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src" / "standalone_trimmed_truth.py"
+    subprocess.run(
+        [
+            sys.executable,
+            "-I",
+            "-S",
+            "-c",
+            "import runpy, sys; "
+            "parse = runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1])['strtobool_trimmed']; "
+            "assert parse(' YES ') is True; "
+            "assert '_pytest.config' not in sys.modules",
+            str(path),
+        ],
+        check=True,
+    )
notes:
